ios.desc:
NovelADV is a novel x adventure creation app for building branching stories with AI. Set your world and characters, then chat with AI NPCs to move the story forward. Templates, checkpoints, summaries, and mystery tracking help keep long-form stories coherent. You can export to Markdown and choose between OpenRouter and local LLM support for different workflows.

[Highlights]
- Organize each work on a project shelf.
- Create scenes through AI-driven chat.
- Control world settings, character profiles, tone, narration, and relationships.
- Track hidden truths, foreshadowing, and mysteries for consistency.
- Use checkpoints and summaries to manage branching stories.
- Save, share, and reuse templates.

Start with a small story, then grow it into a visual-novel-style branching experience.

show_hn.title: Show HN: NovelADV – AI-assisted visual novel writing on iOS

quotes.text:
I enjoy writing visual novels, but keeping track of branching plots, characters and clues on a phone was messy. To make the process smoother, I built NovelADV, an iOS workspace for AI‑assisted fiction.

NovelADV works like a chat‑based visual novel engine. You advance your story by talking to your characters; the app keeps a ledger of world details, characters and unresolved “clues” beside the chat so you don’t lose track of them. It also saves “checkpoints” so you can safely roll back to any decision point and explore alternate paths. To help with longer arcs, there’s a summary‑based long‑term memory that compresses earlier scenes into a short narrative so the AI doesn’t forget context.

The initial motivation was to combine the fun of playing a visual novel with the flexibility of writing one, all on a phone. I’d love feedback from writers and developers experimenting with AI‑assisted storytelling – is this approach useful, or does it introduce new pitfalls?

There’s a free tier on the App Store (link below). a pre‑built sample project are available . Feel free to try it and tell me what works, what doesn’t, or what you’d like to see improved.
